parameters.query: SELECT current_mode FROM user_states WHERE chat_id = {{ $('Telegram Trigger').item.json.message.chat.id }};
INSERT INTO user_states (chat_id, current_mode) VALUES ({{ $json.chatId }}, '{{ $json.newMode }}') ON CONFLICT (chat_id) DO UPDATE SET current_mode = '{{ $json.newMode }}', last_updated = NOW();

assignments.name: recipesGreeting
assignments.value:
=👩‍🍳 *Recipe & Costing Mode Active*

Turn your raw ingredients into profitable products. Manage your formulas and track your margins in real-time.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🛠️ **Build your Recipe:**
• **Create:** `create recipe "Carrot Cake" yields 1 unit`
• **Add:** `add 200g Flour to "Carrot Cake"`
• **Steps:** `set instructions for "Carrot Cake": Bake at 180°C...`

📊 **Analysis & Action:**
• **Cost:** `how much does "Carrot Cake" cost?`
• **Details:** `what is in the "Carrot Cake"?`
• **Production:** `cooked 2 "Carrot Cake"` _(Auto-subtracts stock!)_
• **List:** `show all recipes`

🗑️ **Modify:**
• `remove "Flour" from "Carrot Cake"`
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Type *exit* to return to the main menu.
